limitations: Restricted to squarefree products of exactly three distinct odd primes; all fixed-least-prime fibers are finite but no global infinitude or count claimed. Unindexed prior-work overlap possible.
scientific_integrity: All infinite quantifiers are supported by an algebraic proof; independent exact finite enumeration for p=3,5 is corroboration, not proof of global completeness. No independent validation has taken place.
title: A finite divisor sieve for three-prime positive-shift Carmichael equations
